name: Link As Popup
description: A link-field extension adding target-attribute options including opening in a popup.
project_description:
Features 
 Link field extension that which permits link target attribute options including to open in a Modal (uses Javascript, not a true HTML Dialog) on current page or in a chromeless new window. With size (width/height) options controls per field value.

 Post-Installation 
 Provides additional Link Widget and Formatter for Link Field types. Configure via the Entity Structure (node, terms, users, etc) which have Link fields.
